accessibility: A native file picker is available through the drop area button. Each progress indicator and cancel action identifies its file.

The preview dialog traps keyboard focus, restores focus on close, and keeps background controls inert. Escape closes the preview when focus is in the page; browser PDF viewers may handle keyboard events separately.

guidance: Use it for installation commands, examples, and registry source.
Use prose for short identifiers rather than a code block.
behavior: Shiki highlights source on the server.
Long source starts at previewLines and animates to its measured height in normal page flow.
Copy feedback changes without moving nearby content.
accessibility: Line numbers are hidden from assistive technology.
Long horizontal lines remain keyboard-scrollable.
Copy and disclosure controls expose their state.
api: Source text to highlight and copy.

groups.name: Text Animation
groups.description: Reveal, morph, scramble, and rolling-number primitives built with Motion.

components.name: text-reveal
components.title: Text Reveal
components.description: Accessible character, word, and line reveals triggered in view.
components.lede: Reveals text by character, word, or line once it enters view.
components.installation: Installs Text Reveal and shared motion tokens.
guidance: Use it for short editorial emphasis.
Do not use it for dense or continuously changing content.
behavior: Characters, words, and lines use the shared motion curve.
Content remains readable when reduced motion is enabled.
Blur is enabled by default and follows the reveal timing and stagger; reduced motion disables blur and translation.
accessibility: Screen readers receive one complete text value.
Decorative split spans are hidden from assistive technology.
api: Starts each part at 6px blur and sharpens it during the reveal. Set false to disable. Disabled with reduced motion.
Explicit lines when by="line"; otherwise newline characters define the lines.
Reveal once when true; replay on re-entry when false.

examples.title: Reveal without blur

components.name: morphing-text
components.title: Morphing Text
components.description: Measured text transitions that keep shared characters still.
components.lede: Changes interface labels by keeping shared text in place and scrolling only the changed suffix or characters.
components.installation: Installs Morphing Text and shared motion tokens.
guidance: Use it for a small set of related status labels.
Keep state labels concise so the changed portion remains legible.
behavior: Shared prefixes remain still.
Outgoing characters scroll up and incoming characters scroll from below.
accessibility: The complete active text is exposed as a single accessible value.
Reduced motion swaps the text without scrolling.

components.name: scramble-text
components.title: Scramble Text
components.description: Accessible random-character text resolution animation for React.
components.lede: Resolves a temporary character scramble into a final text value.
components.installation: Installs Scramble Text and shared motion tokens.
guidance: Use it sparingly for a short status or decorative moment.
Do not use it where people need to read a value immediately.
behavior: Characters resolve in a deterministic sequence.
The shared curve and reduced-motion behavior keep it readable.
accessibility: Assistive technology receives the final text rather than random characters.

components.name: rolling-number
components.title: Rolling Number
components.description: Accessible rolling digit transitions for changing numeric values.
components.lede: Transitions changing numbers digit by digit with an odometer-like scroll.
components.installation: Installs Rolling Number and shared motion tokens.
guidance: Use it for a value that changes meaningfully over time.
Avoid it for editable text fields; use Number Input instead.
behavior: Digits step through intermediate values instead of jumping to the target.
A small blur during scroll keeps fast changes readable.
The final step eases into the target.
accessibility: The current complete number is exposed as text.
Reduced motion updates the number without rolling.
